identity.name: Job Listing
identity.definition: A time-bound federal vacancy announcement for a specific position at a specific agency.

structure.evidence: positionTitle, announcementNumber, openDate, closeDate, salary, location, duties, qualifications, status, applyUrl — sufficient for a full detail page.

instances.evidence: IT Specialist GS-13 at Dept of Defense; Park Ranger GS-7 at National Park Service; Border Patrol Agent GS-11 at CBP.

purpose.evidence: Job seekers browse and evaluate listings to decide whether to apply.

sipValidation.verdict: Valid object. Time-bound, agency-specific, and navigable with a full detail page.

synonyms.notes: Formal term used in hiring regulations. Interchangeable with Job Listing in this system.

synonyms.context: USAJobs Help Center and applicant-facing copy
Federal HR practitioners and agency HR staff
synonyms.notes: Acronym for Job Opportunity Announcement. Not used in applicant-facing copy.

attributes.name: positionTitle
attributes.description: The title of the position as defined by the hiring agency.

attributes.name: announcementNumber
attributes.description: The public-facing identifier for the listing, assigned by the agency.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the listing.

attributes.name: closingType
attributes.description: How the listing closes. Determines whether closeDate is present.

attributes.name: totalOpenings
attributes.description: The number of available positions, or a qualitative indicator when the exact count is not disclosed.

attributes.name: openDate
attributes.description: The date applications opened.

attributes.name: closeDate
attributes.description: The application deadline. Absent when closingType is Continuous.

attributes.name: workSchedule
attributes.description: The employment schedule for the position.

attributes.name: appointmentType
attributes.description: The duration and nature of the appointment.

attributes.name: serviceType
attributes.description: The federal service classification governing the position.

attributes.name: supervisoryStatus
attributes.description: Whether the role includes supervisory responsibilities.

attributes.name: travelRequirement
attributes.description: Expected travel frequency.

attributes.name: relocationAssistance
attributes.description: Whether relocation expenses are reimbursed.

attributes.name: teleworkEligible
attributes.description: Whether remote work is available for this position.

attributes.name: securityClearance
attributes.description: The security clearance level required.

attributes.name: drugTestRequired
attributes.description: Whether a drug test is required.

attributes.name: whoMayApply
attributes.description: Plain-text summary of who is eligible to apply.

attributes.name: hiringPaths
attributes.description: Delimited list of hiring path codes indicating which applicant groups are eligible. References the deferred Hiring Path object. Treated as a string for v1.

attributes.name: promotionPotential
attributes.description: The highest grade this position can reach through non-competitive promotion.

attributes.name: duties
attributes.description: Full description of the position's responsibilities.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Overview paragraph describing the position and agency context.

attributes.name: howToApply
attributes.description: Instructions for completing and submitting an application.

attributes.name: requiredDocuments
attributes.description: Documents the applicant must submit with their application.

attributes.name: benefits
attributes.description: Description of benefits available for this position.

attributes.name: applyUrl
attributes.description: URL to the agency's external application system. The redesign links here; it does not accept applications.

actions.name: Apply
actions.description: Links to the agency's external application system. Not a POST. The redesign does not accept applications.

actions.name: Save listing
actions.description: Saves the listing for later review. Requires state persistence.

actions.name: Share listing
actions.description: Copies or shares a direct URL to the listing.

actions.name: View similar listings
actions.description: Navigates to a filtered list of listings in the same occupational series and location.

actions.name: Check eligibility
actions.description: Surfaces whether the job seeker's hiring path matches the listing's requirements.

actions.name: Print / export listing
actions.description: Produces a printable or exportable version of the listing.

relationships.mechanics: Automatic. Agency code on the listing maps to the Agency object via the API. Set when the listing is published. Read-only from the redesign side.
relationships.cardinality: many-to-one (one Agency has many Job Listings; one listing belongs to one agency)
relationships.sorts: Default: openDate descending. Options: closeDate ascending, salary descending.
relationships.filters: Series, location, grade, appointment type, work schedule, telework eligibility.
relationships.dependencies: Required. A listing cannot exist without an agency. If agency data is unavailable, the listing renders in a degraded state (name only, no logo or description). No cascade — orphaned listings are not deleted.

relationships.mechanics: Automatic. Series code on the listing maps to the Occupational Series object via the API.
relationships.cardinality: many-to-one (one Occupational Series has many Job Listings; one listing belongs to one series)
relationships.sorts: Default: openDate descending. Options: salary descending, grade descending, closeDate ascending.
relationships.filters: Agency, location, grade, appointment type, telework eligibility.
relationships.dependencies: Required. A listing must have a valid series code.

relationships.mechanics: Automatic. One or more location records on the listing map to Location objects via the API.
relationships.cardinality: many-to-many (one Location has many Job Listings; one listing can be at multiple Locations — typically 1 to 3, up to dozens for nationwide postings)
relationships.sorts: Default: openDate descending. Options: salary descending, grade descending, series alphabetical.
relationships.filters: Series, agency, grade, appointment type, telework eligibility.
relationships.dependencies: Required unless teleworkEligible is true. A fully remote listing may have no physical location. No cascade — if location data changes, listings retain their recorded location values.

relationships.mechanics: Automatic. Grade and pay scale on the listing map to the Salary Range object via the API.
relationships.cardinality: many-to-one (one Salary Range covers many Job Listings; one listing has one Salary Range)
relationships.sorts: Default: openDate descending. Options: grade descending, series alphabetical.
relationships.dependencies: Required. A listing must have salary information.

nestedObjects.name: Qualification
nestedObjects.description: Experience and education requirements for the position, organized by grade level. Qualifications have no existence outside a specific listing.

views.context: A Job Listing in search results.
views.userIntent: Scan listings to find ones worth reading in full.

views.context: A Job Listing reviewed by a job seeker.
views.userIntent: Determine whether the position is worth applying for.

stories.title: First-time applicant evaluates a listing
stories.benefit: understands whether they are eligible and what the role involves before investing time in an application
stories.whenClause: When a job seeker opens a listing from search results
stories.thenClause: They can see the position title, salary, location, qualifications, and a direct path to apply

stories.title: Job seeker saves a listing to review later
stories.benefit: can return to promising listings without repeating the search
stories.whenClause: When a job seeker wants to compare multiple listings before deciding
stories.thenClause: The listing appears in their saved listings for later review

businessRules.title: Apply requires Open status
businessRules.description: Apply is only available when status is Open and applyUrl is present. If either condition is not met, Apply is hidden and the primary CTA falls back to Save listing.

businessRules.title: closeDate conditional on closingType
businessRules.description: closeDate is required unless closingType is Continuous. Continuous listings have no fixed deadline.

businessRules.title: Location or remote required
businessRules.description: At least one Location is required, or teleworkEligible must be true. A listing cannot have neither.

businessRules.title: At least one Qualification required
businessRules.description: Every listing must have at least one Qualification nested object.

businessRules.title: No submission
businessRules.description: The redesign does not accept applications. Apply always links out to the agency's external system. The redesign cannot POST back to USAJobs or any agency system.

businessRules.title: One primary CTA per role
businessRules.description: Job seekers have one primary CTA: Apply. If Apply is unavailable (status is not Open or applyUrl is absent), the primary CTA is Save listing.

states.name: Closed
states.description: The listing is no longer accepting applications.
states.triggers: closeDate is reached, the applicant limit is hit, or the agency closes the listing manually.

states.name: Cancelled
states.description: The listing was withdrawn before it closed.
